mechanism: Both drugs can prolong QT interval and trimethoprim may inhibit renal clearance of moxifloxacin; additive effects on cardiac conduction and potential for reduced fluoroquinolone efficacy in renal impairment.
action: Monitor QTc interval and renal function; use with caution in patients with baseline QT prolongation, electrolyte abnormalities, or renal impairment; ensure adequate hydration.
